create.name: Heceliza Perez
create.bio:
Heceliza Perez teaches Reiki at master-teacher level and also works with breathwork and sound from her base in Long Beach, California. After an MBA she worked in corporate fashion in New York, then left that career in 2017 for Bali and several years of travel and remote work with her husband. Along the way she studied with teachers in a range of energy practices, including the Akashic Records and Human Design, and began offering group and individual energy sessions online in 2020, which widened her client base well beyond California.

Her sessions combine Reiki with guided meditation, conscious breathing, sound instruments and oracle cards, and are offered over video call or in person around Long Beach, as well as for couples and for circles marking full moons, birthdays and other occasions. She teaches Reiki Level 1 as a small in-person weekend, runs a longer group training for people who want to work as energy practitioners, and brings breathwork, meditation and sound to teams in Southern California workplaces. Her central message is that each person can learn to be their own healer and their own guide, and she speaks particularly to first-generation women breaking old family patterns.

courses.title: Virtual Energy Healing - Reiki Session
courses.description: A 70-minute session over video call that opens with conversation, moves through guided relaxation with breath and sound, and then gives Reiki while the client lies down at home. It closes with time to talk over what came up and an oracle card.

courses.title: Virtual 1:1 Breathwork Session
courses.description: An 80-minute online session of sustained active breathing for around half an hour, followed by slower breathing and some Reiki. Heceliza talks with the client before and after the breathing.

courses.title: Wellness in the Workplace
courses.description: Sessions of 90 to 120 minutes for teams and managers in Southern California, built from breathwork, guided meditation and sound. Each one is shaped to the group's own goals.

courses.title: Partner Work and Group Circles
courses.description: Online or in-person sessions for two people or a gathered group, centred on breathwork with Reiki, meditation, card pulls and sound. Circles can be themed around a full moon, a birthday or another occasion.

free_resources.title: Heceliza Perez on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer profile, with guided meditations on energy, intuition and balance. The tracks are free to play.

free_resources.title: Free Energy and Intuition Meditation
free_resources.description: A short guided practice for connecting with your own energy and intuition, sent by email when you join her newsletter.

Her work is not mainly condition-led, so she is listed, but those claims are kept out of every description; a human may want to check.
Session prices ($150 each) read from her Acuity booking pages (Heceliza.as.me/Reiki and /Breathwork), which are linked from her Private Sessions page.
Photos are from her own About and home pages (black-and-white and colour shots, same person); no YouTube or other source to cross-check.
Partner Work and Group Circles shares the Services page URL with the private sessions page (the two 1:1 sessions use their own booking URLs).
